name: Scality
description: This plugin supports ingestion of Alerts (DLP, Malware, Policy, Compromised Credential, Malsite, Quarantine, Remediation, Security Assessment, Watchlist, UBA, CTEP, Device, Content), Events (Page, Application, Audit, Infrastructure, Network, Incident, Endpoint, Client Status) and WebTx data to a Scality bucket. This plugin supports ingestion in JSON format only.

configuration.label: Scality Endpoint URL
configuration.description: Endpoint URL of the Scality instance.

configuration.label: Access Key
configuration.description: Access Key for the Scality instance.

configuration.label: Secret Access Key
configuration.description: Secret Access Key for the Scality instance.

configuration.label: Scality Bucket Name
configuration.description: Name of the Scality bucket in which the log objects will be stored. The bucket must already exist on Scality.
